questions.question: Stop admits Stopping; can a late observeRecognitionStarted -> Listening from the earlier BeginLocalDictation overwrite it?
questions.expected: FENCED — STOP realizes End, which sets dictation.desiredActive = false and increments dictation.session (L1193–L1194). Begin re-checks `!dictation.desiredActive || session !== dictation.session` after every await and returns before applying recognitionStartedState (L1343 before L1351). A late recognition-started cannot move STOPPING/READY to LISTENING.

evidence.note: Fence lives in generated browser JavaScript, not typed Family law; executing it needs a browser-runtime harness (proof class C) that this lane does not have.
